cases.description: When the validator's suppressSubSchemaRetrieval flag is true, fetchSubSchemaNode must short‑circuit and return null regardless of the supplied ValidationContext.
Even if a null ValidationContext is passed, the suppressSubSchemaRetrieval flag takes precedence and the method must still return null.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance (the schema returned by obtainSubSchemaNode)
cases.description: With suppressSubSchemaRetrieval set to false, the method should delegate to the private static obtainSubSchemaNode, passing the current schemaNode and the provided ValidationContext, and return the resulting JsonSchema.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance (the schema returned by obtainSubSchemaNode when validationContext is null)
cases.description: When suppressSubSchemaRetrieval is false and a null ValidationContext is supplied, fetchSubSchemaNode must still call obtainSubSchemaNode with the current schemaNode and null, returning the JsonSchema produced by that call.

When suppressSubSchemaRetrieval is false but the validator's schemaNode field is null, fetchSubSchemaNode should call obtainSubSchemaNode with a null schemaNode and return whatever that method returns – in the current implementation this is null.
Even when the supplied ValidationContext is null, a null schemaNode still leads obtainSubSchemaNode to return null, so fetchSubSchemaNode must return null.

When the validator holds a schemaNode that is an ObjectNode with a $ref (e.g. {"$ref":"#/definitions/foo"}) and suppressSubSchemaRetrieval is false, fetchSubSchemaNode must delegate to obtainSubSchemaNode, which resolves the reference against the ValidationContext's base URI. The returned JsonSchema should therefore represent the resolved definition.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema (reference resolved relative to the schemaNode's own URI, if any)
cases.description: If the ValidationContext is null, obtainSubSchemaNode should still be able to resolve a $ref using the schemaNode's internal $id (or default to empty). The test verifies that fetchSubSchemaNode does not throw and returns a JsonSchema instance.

group: fetchSubSchemaNode - validationContext with custom base URI

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema whose base URI is "http://other.com/api"
cases.description: When a ValidationContext with a different base URI is supplied, fetchSubSchemaNode must forward it to obtainSubSchemaNode. The resulting JsonSchema should carry the supplied base URI, confirming that the method does not alter the context.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema whose base URI is "file:/tmp/schema.json"
cases.description: Ensures that file‑scheme base URIs are also propagated correctly through fetchSubSchemaNode.

group: fetchSubSchemaNode - suppressSubSchemaRetrieval = false, but obtainSubSchemaNode throws

input.value: mocked ValidationContext that causes obtainSubSchemaNode to throw IllegalArgumentException

cases.description: If obtainSubSchemaNode throws an unchecked exception (e.g., because the schemaNode is malformed), fetchSubSchemaNode must not catch it; the exception should propagate to the caller.

When suppressSubSchemaRetrieval is false and the static obtainSubSchemaNode method is forced (via mocking) to throw a NullPointerException (e.g., because an internal null reference is accessed), fetchSubSchemaNode must not catch it and let the exception bubble up.
If obtainSubSchemaNode detects an illegal validator state (e.g., missing required schema attributes) and throws IllegalStateException, fetchSubSchemaNode should propagate the exception unchanged.

group: fetchSubSchemaNode - obtainSubSchemaNode throws URISyntaxException (wrapped as IllegalArgumentException)

input.value: mocked ValidationContext with malformed base URI "http://[invalid]"

cases.description: When the ValidationContext contains a malformed URI, obtainSubSchemaNode may attempt to resolve a $ref and throw a URISyntaxException wrapped in IllegalArgumentException. fetchSubSchemaNode must not swallow it.

If schemaNode is of an unexpected JSON node type (e.g., an ArrayNode) and obtainSubSchemaNode casts it to ObjectNode, a ClassCastException may be thrown. fetchSubSchemaNode must let this exception propagate.
When obtainSubSchemaNode reads an external schema reference and encounters an I/O problem, it can throw IOException. fetchSubSchemaNode should not catch it, allowing the caller to handle the failure.
